en: initialism of Федера́льное бюро́ рассле́дований (Federálʹnoje bjuró rasslédovanij, “Federal Bureau of Investigation”): FBI

initialism of Фонд борьбы́ с корру́пцией (Fond borʹbý s korrúpcijej): "FBK", Anti-Corruption Foundation (was a Russian non-profit organization based in Moscow established in 2011 by activist and politician Alexei Navalny.)
